raw:
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN pz2.borough = 'Manhattan' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage 
FROM trips t 
JOIN zones pz ON t.do_location_id = pz.location_id 
JOIN zones pz2 ON t.pu_location_id = pz2.location 
WHERE pz.zone = 'LaGuardia Airport';

raw: SELECT day_of_week_name, AVG(t.trip_distance) FROM trips t JOIN (SELECT CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) AS week_day, CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) = 0 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) = 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) =  3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) = 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) = 5 THEN 'Friday' ELSE 'Saturday' END AS day_of_week_name FROM trips t) AS day_map ON CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) = day_map.week_day GROUP BY day_of_week_name ORDER BY AVG(t.trip_distance) DESC LIMIT 1;
sql: SELECT day_of_week_name, AVG(t.trip_distance) FROM trips t JOIN (SELECT CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) AS week_day, CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) = 0 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) = 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) =  3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) = 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) = 5 THEN 'Friday' ELSE 'Saturday' END AS day_of_week_name FROM trips t) AS day_map ON CAST(strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) = day_map.week_day GROUP BY day_of_week_name ORDER BY AVG(t.trip_distance) DESC LIMIT 1;
